dedupe_keys.name: goiener raw simel smart meter records

description: GoiEner and the University of Deusto publish the original SIMEL smart-meter records underlying the cooperative's electricity-profile release. The Zenodo deposit describes 71,048 compressed source files covering late 2014 to June 2022, including consumption, self-generation, contracted power, prices and billing information. The files are distributed in an approximately 8 GB ZIP archive, free under CC BY 4.0. They provide an earlier processing stage than the hourly CSV profiles in data-goiener-smart-meter-data-spain. Reprocessing can support demand, tariff and agent-based electricity simulations with model-pypsa. A caveat is that these are customers of one Spanish cooperative, not a representative national sample. Source records require parsing and cleaning, and their fields should not be assumed identical to the derived series. Repository metadata were read without downloading meter-level or billing records.
